paper_title: Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech
caption: Original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. Percentages are displayed with respect to number of utterances.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the original distribution of emotion categories within the IEMOCAP dataset, displaying a total of six distinct slices. Each category is represented by a specific color with its corresponding numerical percentage labeled directly inside the slice, while the text labels for the emotions are positioned outside the chart adjacent to their respective segments. The chart does not include a separate legend, nor does it feature any visually emphasized, offset, or exploded slices. The largest proportion is labeled "Frustration," appearing in light blue at 25.1%, followed by "Neutral" in purple at 23.1%. The remaining categories consist of "Anger" in yellow at 14.9%, "Sadness" in orange at 14.7%, "Excitement" in red at 14.1%, and "Happiness" in medium blue at 8.1%. Visually, the segments do not appear to be arranged in a strict ascending or descending order by size around the circle.
